versions.content: Routing on the fly If routing on the fly is not possible in case: • there is more than one destination routing path or • the routing path uses the Interface (IF) API instead of Transport Protocol (TP) API then IPduMapping . pdurTpChunkSize will be ignored in the Ecu configuration.
